sections.title: Lord of the Flies — Chapter 9 (summary, 2)

paras.text: A thunderstorm breaks. Ralph taunts Jack that his tribe has no shelters; the littluns panic, and Jack starts the hunting dance. All the boys, Ralph and Piggy included, join the frenzied circle chanting “Kill the beast!”

Simon stumbles out of the forest into the circle, trying to tell them about the dead man on the hill. In the dark and rain the crazed boys take him for the beast, surround him and beat him to death; his body is left on the sand.

The storm wind fills the parachute and carries the dead pilot off the mountain, over the beach and out to sea, scattering the boys. After midnight the rain stops, the tide rises, and Simon’s body is carried gently out into the open sea.

sections.title: Lord of the Flies — Chapter 10 (summary, 1)

paras.text: Next morning Ralph and Piggy, bruised and shaken, talk about Simon. Piggy urges Ralph to treat it as an accident; Ralph cannot understand what came over him. With Samneric they avoid speaking of the murder, each claiming to have left the feast early.

sections.theory:
CHAPTER 10

Next morning Ralph and Piggy, bruised and shaken, talk about Simon. Piggy urges Ralph to treat it as an accident; Ralph cannot understand what came over him. With Samneric they avoid speaking of the murder, each claiming to have left the feast early.

At Castle Rock, Jack’s camp has a lever log ready to send a rock crashing down on intruders, and a boy, Wilfred, has been tied up and beaten on Jack’s orders for no known reason. Jack, now a painted, near-naked chief, plans a hunt and a night raid to take fire from Ralph’s group.

At the beach Ralph’s small group struggles to keep the fire going and agrees to make smoke only by day. That night, in the shelter, they hear something outside whispering “Piggy… come outside”. (continued on p. 213)

باب 10

اگلی صبح رالف اور پگی، زخمی اور لرزے ہوئے، سائمن کے بارے میں بات کرتے ہیں۔ پگی رالف پر زور دیتا ہے کہ اسے حادثہ سمجھے؛ رالف نہیں سمجھ پاتا کہ اس پر کیا طاری ہو گیا تھا۔ سیمنیرک کے ساتھ وہ قتل کا ذکر کرنے سے بچتے ہیں، ہر ایک دعویٰ کرتا ہے کہ وہ دعوت سے جلدی چلا گیا تھا۔

کیسل راک پر جیک کے ٹھکانے میں ایک لیور تنا تیار ہے جو گھسنے والوں پر چٹان لڑھکا سکتا ہے، اور ایک لڑکا، ولفریڈ، جیک کے حکم پر بغیر کسی معلوم وجہ کے باندھ کر مارا گیا ہے۔ جیک، اب رنگا ہوا، تقریباً ننگا سردار، شکار اور رالف کی ٹولی سے آگ چھیننے کے لیے رات کے حملے کا منصوبہ بناتا ہے۔

ساحل پر رالف کی چھوٹی ٹولی آگ جلائے رکھنے کی جدوجہد کرتی ہے اور صرف دن میں دھواں کرنے پر متفق ہوتی ہے۔ اس رات جھونپڑی میں انہیں باہر کوئی چیز سرگوشی کرتی سنائی دیتی ہے: ’’پگی… باہر آؤ‘‘۔ (صفحہ 213 پر جاری)

sections.content:
CHAPTER 10

Next morning Ralph and Piggy, bruised and shaken, talk about Simon. Piggy urges Ralph to treat it as an accident; Ralph cannot understand what came over him. With Samneric they avoid speaking of the murder, each claiming to have left the feast early.

At Castle Rock, Jack’s camp has a lever log ready to send a rock crashing down on intruders, and a boy, Wilfred, has been tied up and beaten on Jack’s orders for no known reason. Jack, now a painted, near-naked chief, plans a hunt and a night raid to take fire from Ralph’s group.

At the beach Ralph’s small group struggles to keep the fire going and agrees to make smoke only by day. That night, in the shelter, they hear something outside whispering “Piggy… come outside”. (continued on p. 213)
